page_title: BOU 0-4 LIV | Bournemouth v Liverpool 21/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Andy Madley had an easy-decision to make.
90+5' Kieffer Moore (Bournemouth) picks up a wayward pass but gives away possession by shooting from distance. The ball went miles wide of the right post.
90+4' The game is interrupted now, Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90+3' Substitution. Diogo Jota makes his way off the pitch and Kaide Gordon (Liverpool) comes on as his replacement.

90+3' 0 - 4 Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) meets a perfect cross from Joe Gomez deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the bottom right corner via the post. The score is 0:4.
90+2' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
83' Lewis Cook will be replaced by Philip Billing (Bournemouth).
83' Andoni Iraola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kieffer Moore (Bournemouth) replacing Dominic Solanke.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Bobby Clark (Liverpool) comes onto the pitch for Conor Bradley.
83' Curtis Jones has picked up an injury and is replaced by Owen Beck (Liverpool).
82' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) picks up an injury.
79' 0 - 3 Goal! Diogo Jota (Liverpool) takes a short pass from Conor Bradley in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner. 0:3.
78' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
78' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Lewis Cook (Bournemouth). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
77' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) gets to the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
76' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Liverpool.
76' Maximillian Aarons (Bournemouth) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
75' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
74' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth).
73' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but Neto comes off his line to gather the ball.
70' 0 - 2 Cody Gakpo passes the ball into the penalty area. Diogo Jota (Liverpool) collects it and quickly sends it into the bottom right corner via the post! The goalkeeper was helpless. 0:2!
70' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
69' Andoni Iraola decides to make a substitution. Justin Kluivert will be replaced by David Brooks (Bournemouth).
66' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) has tested the patience of referee Andy Madley and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
64' Here comes a substitution. Harvey Elliott is given a rest as he is replaced by Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool).
64' Jurgen Klopp has decided to make a change. Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) replaces Luis Diaz.
62' Bournemouth will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
59' Andy Madley shows a yellow card to Lewis Cook (Bournemouth), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
55' Here comes a substitution. Alex Scott (Bournemouth) is brought on as a substitute for Luis Sinisterra.
55' Andoni Iraola prepares a substitution. James Hill is replaced by Lloyd Kelly (Bournemouth).
54' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
53' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) latched on to a precise cross, but his bullet header missed the target. He should have done much better.
51' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

51' That's unlucky! Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Now Bournemouth have a corner.
49' 0 - 1 Goal! Diogo Jota plays a pass to the feet of Darwin Nunez (Liverpool), and he shoots into the bottom right corner from inside the box. It's 0:1.
48' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
47' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
46' Referee Andy Madley blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+1' The corner lands on the head of Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) in the middle of the box and he tries to guide his header into the far right corner, but it's misjudged and goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
45+1' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) prepares to take a corner kick.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
41' A snap shot from distance by Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) after a precise pass is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
40' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) receives a pass then lets rip from long range low towards the middle of the goal, but Alisson watches it all the way and makes an easy save.
39' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
36' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
35' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) receives a pass, beats an opponent and tries a long-range shot. It's a weak effort low towards the middle of the goal and Neto easily makes the save.

30' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
28' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Darwin Nunez, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
27' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
26' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

26' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) sends a cross in and finds Luis Diaz inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger. The referee points to the corner flag and Liverpool will take a corner.

25' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) controls a neat pass and has options, but decides to shoot from distance. The ball flies towards the middle of the goal, but Neto is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
23' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
22' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) sprays a pass out to Conor Bradley, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.

20' What an opportunity! Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
19' 0:0 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
17' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
14' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
11' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
9' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Andy Madley blows for a foul. Bournemouth will take a free kick near the side line.
8' The resulting corner from Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
7' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alisson, who smothers the ball. The ball is out of play. Bournemouth win a corner kick.
7' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
6' Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Bournemouth get a corner.
5' Liverpool control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
2' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) whips in a cross from the corner, but Alisson is well positioned and punches the ball away.
2' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
1' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) works the corner short.
1' The first half has started.
Bournemouth will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Andy Madley.
